instruction: I want to see all of my email folders, not just the main ones. Can you help me switch the folder pane to 'All Folders' view in Thunderbird so I can see every folder in my accounts?

metadata.explanation: Task requires switching Thunderbird folder pane to 'All Folders' mode. The evaluator checks xulstore.json for folderTree.mode set to 'all'. Similar pattern to original task which checks for 'smart' mode. Same complexity level.
metadata.verification: Verified that xulstore.json stores folderTree mode settings. The check_json metric with regex match is appropriate for verifying the mode is set to 'all'.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly targets xulstore.json, which is the proper file where Thunderbird stores UI state and folder pane mode settings
JSON path ['chrome://messenger/content/messenger.xhtml']['folderTree']['mode'] is semantically correct for accessing the folder tree mode setting
Regex pattern '\ball\b' appropriately checks for 'all' mode with word boundaries, ensuring accurate verification
Postconfig properly closes Thunderbird window before reading xulstore.json, which is essential because Thunderbird writes UI state to this file on shutdown
Complete requirement coverage: evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction (folder pane switched to 'All Folders' view)
check_json function includes robust error handling for file existence, parsing errors, and key navigation failures
No missing verification steps - single-requirement task is fully verified by the evaluator

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
